verdict.rationale: Stable's own marketing describes keyword-based rules that auto-route incoming mail to the right team, an AI inbox that automatically sorts and routes mail, automated check deposits, and configurable Slack/email alerts on new mail. Together these amount to event-triggered automation tied to mail arrival. The evidence is marketing-level only and limited to mail routing, deposit and notification actions. missing for 10: documentation of a general rule builder (conditions, triggers, configurable actions), rules beyond mail routing and alerts, programmatic or API-defined rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
